title: RefundRequest
description: A request for performing a refund

refundOperations.description: A list of refund operations which will specify order line, optionally where in the product tree the change occurs, and how much money should be refunded with this change

includesCancelledOrderLines.description: Lets refund know that the request will include already cancelled order lines, and to handle them accordingly

OrderReference.description: Wrapper detailing a OrderReference to an instance
OrderReference.title: OrderReference

PerformRefundEntry.description: A refund 'operation' that describes which order line, and which elements in that order line product tree that is to be refunded

refundOperations.description: A list of identifiers for which element(s) in the order lines product tree that is to be refunded

refundRule.description: The refund rule that is to be used with this entry.

PerformRefundEntry.title: PerformRefundEntry

ProductElementIdentifier.description: A type for depicting where an element resides in a sales package tree

fareStructureElementIndex.description: The index of the element on the farestructure element level

fareproductIndex.description: The index of the element on the fareproduct level

validableElementIndex.description: The index of the element on the validable element level

ProductElementIdentifier.title: ProductElementIdentifier

ProductsElementWrapper.description: A data-wrapper for a product type

id.description: The id of the product type

name.description: The name of the product type

version.description: The version of the product type

ProductsElementWrapper.title: ProductsElementWrapper

TerminalRefundingData.description: Holder for data that needs to be provided when performing a refund on an external terminal

additionalData.description: Any extra transaction data which could be relevant can be specified as a key value map of strings. If there exists keys here that clash with specific types in this request, the fields in the request are prioritized

baxNumber.description: When performing an offline refund to card terminal, the BAX-number is mandatory info

obfuscatedCardNumber.description: The obfuscated value of the card number the refund was performed against

paymentType.description: The type of payment method that is provided to the terminal for refunding

rrn.description: Reconciliation reference number used to track an order (transaction) through different economy systems. Generated by a terminal

terminalId.description: When performing an offline refund to card terminal, the terminal id is mandatory info

transactionConfirmedAt.description: Datetime when credit transaction was completed externally by the client.

TerminalRefundingData.title: TerminalRefundingData
